title: moduleGroup
responsibility: Resolves a category from owned source paths and scores clear category matches.

inputs.name: modulePath.path
inputs.description: Module source path whose first src/ segment is followed by a moduleFolders name, then '/' and more text; any text before that src/ is kept in root as the package prefix. Paths without that shape make modulePath return undefined.

inputs.name: moduleGroup.paths
inputs.description: Owned source paths scanned for a category: a path counts when modulePath gives it a folder that is followed by another segment and equals a group id once the parentheses of a route-group folder such as (marketing) are removed. Other paths are ignored, and folder aliases are consulted only when no path counts.

inputs.name: moduleGroup.groups
inputs.description: Category definitions matched by exact id against each counted path's folder. A group's optional folders are raw string prefixes of owned paths, not whole segments, used as aliases only when no path counts, and only the longest matching prefixes are used.

inputs.name: matchingGroups.text
inputs.description: Text to match, normalized by splitting camelCase after a lowercase letter or digit, lowercasing it, and replacing each run of characters other than ASCII letters and digits with one space. A group's id or term matches only when its words appear in that normalized text as a whole-word sequence.

inputs.name: matchingGroups.groups
inputs.description: Categories scored against the text: each group's id and terms are lowercased and split only at non-alphanumeric characters, with camelCase left unsplit. A group's score is the largest word count among its id and terms that match the text, and a group with no match scores zero.

outputs.name: moduleFolders
outputs.description: Frozen list of the 39 folder names that modulePath accepts directly after a src/ segment; any other folder name makes modulePath return undefined.

outputs.name: modulePath
outputs.description: Scaffold root: the path through the moduleFolders name after src/, plus the following segment when that name is lib and the segment is stores, utils, helpers, components, services, models, config, or adapters. parts holds the remaining segments, and the value is undefined when the path has no supported src/<folder>/<segment> shape.

outputs.name: moduleGroup
outputs.description: The single matched category's id and title, taken from counted source-folder paths or, when none count, from folder aliases. The value is undefined when no category matches or when two or more different categories match.

outputs.name: matchingGroups
outputs.description: Groups tied for the highest score, in input order, where a group's score is the largest word count among its id and terms that match the text. The array is empty when no score is above zero, including when groups is empty.
